thread:
maria: Quick FYI: saw a billing discrepancy in staging where provisional token waterfall showed ~400 tokens, console confirmed ~320, but synthetic invoice counted ~720. Repro attached.

josh: sounds like double provisional capture + ledger merge. did the stream hit a fallback model?

maria: yes — stream -> tool_call -> client reconnect -> router retried on fallback. Two provisional slices were emitted before the first session finalized.

lee: root cause hypothesis: provisional records keyed only by session_id + chunk_range. reconnect creates a new session_id; ledger stitcher treats them as separate until final confirm, and our finalizer merged both into invoice incorrectly when tool_call retries were present.

ana: Proposal: add a durable billing_attempt_id propagated across reconnects and tool_call hops. ledger should canonicalize by (customer_id, billing_attempt_id, token_window).

josh: Implementation note: add header X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt to streaming API and to internal tool_call RPC. Router should preserve it across handoffs; if missing, synthesize and return to client on reconnect so subsequent sockets include same attempt.

lee: Example header flow: 

```
Client -> POST /v1/stream (X-Redwood-Session: s1, X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt: a1)
Router -> tool_call (inject a1)
Client reconnect -> ws resume (client sends a1)
```

If client doesn't send it, router drops cookie with attempt id.

maria: UX mitigation: console change to default to "confirmed" numbers and collapse provisional. Add a small yellow help pill: "Provisional values are estimates until finalization completes." This reduces panic for SRE/ops.

console-ux: Agreed. Also proposing an optional "smoothing" toggle that applies short-term heuristics like smoothed = max(confirmed, provisional * 0.7) until final; opt-in per org.

ops-bot: Alert suppressed: provisional spike for cust_demo (was 3.5x baseline).

lee: Data retention / cardinality: provisional records TTL = 7d. Adding attempt id will add cardinality but per-session QPS is small. I'll run an index-cost sim. If cost is high, we can shard keys by attempt namespace.

ana: Backwards compat: ledger should fall back to session-based grouping when billing_attempt_id is absent to avoid breaking older clients. Migration doc needed.

maria: Telemetry to add: metrics.streaming.provisional_tokens, metrics.streaming.confirmed_tokens, metrics.billing.attempt_dedupe_collapses. Dashboards: add an "attempts" drilldown that shows tokens by attempt_id for a customer.

josh: Quick win: frontend patch to hide provisional by default + include help copy. I'll raise PR for that today (ISSUE-4701).

lee: I'll open RFC for attempt header + ledger dedupe (RFC-210). Repro script in staging will simulate: stream slices, tool_call, forced reconnects with same attempt id. Posting results once run.

maria: Also add unit tests for ledger dedupe and an e2e against billing-staging. Billing/sre legal should be cc'd.

josh: Thx. For rollout, prefer feature-flagged ledger change so we can mirror-run and compare invoices before flipping.

maria: good point. plan: 1) console hide provisional (ff=false by default) 2) header + router propagation + synth on reconnect (ff rollout) 3) ledger dedupe behind ff + mirror-run 4) enable smoothing toggle in console.

ops-bot: Noted. Ops runbook: if a customer reports similar spike, check traces for multiple session_ids within short window and correlate attempt header.

maria: assigning tasks: ISSUE-4701 (console default) -> @josh, ISSUE-4702 (API header + router) -> @lee, ISSUE-4703 (ledger dedupe + migration) -> @maria. I'll draft a short explainer doc for customers.

josh: I'll write the help doc and add the banner copy.

lee: repro script ETA: today EOD. will include perf/cost sim for index growth.

maria: thanks team. we'll review RFC in tomorrow sync.
